summary: The University of Central Asia Cambridge Scholarship Programme supports graduate study at the University of Cambridge, United Kingdom, in the 2027-2028 academic year. It is for candidates from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan, with applicants from Afghanistan, Pakistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan also considered. Shortlisted applicants then submit a full Cambridge application.
